description: Hetzner Cloud Jenkins plugin (v103.percona.13+): circuit breakers, provisioning latency, rate-limit headroom, API health, capacity vs cap, anomaly counters, and correlated SLF4J logs from /hetzner-prometheus and Loki. v2 (2026-05-12) fixes the idle-fleet success-rate gauge, the Loki level regex, the pending-vs-reap axis collision, the empty-stat label loss on anomaly counters, and adds API and capacity visibility. v3 (2026-05-18) adds panel 50 'Provisioning outcomes by class' so bootstrap_other / rate_limited / dc_unavailable are visible alongside the success-rate gauge. v4 (2026-05-20) adds an Arch variable (All / amd64 / arm64) wired through the template-labelled panels, a per-arch summary row of six stat panels at the top, and a server_type breakdown on the per-location worker chart. Arch split uses the native `arch` label (amd64/arm64) where the plugin emits it (running_servers, dc_circuit_breaker_state and the other DC-health series) and the 'template' regex (x64/aarch64) elsewhere; instance_cap/provisioning_pending have no arch label so capacity utilization stays fleet-wide. v5 (2026-05-27) wires the Arch selector through the native-arch panels (200/203 running, 1/402/404 DC breakers, 401 legacy keys, 5 reap, 403 leaked, 201 Running col), fixes the panel-1 breaker enum (was 1=HALF_OPEN/2=OPEN; source is 0=CLOSED/1=OPEN/2=HALF_OPEN), and keeps 103/201 utilization fleet-wide (cap has no arch).

panels.title: Provisions/min (amd64)
panels.description: Successful AMD64 provisions per minute, 5-minute sliding window. Filters by template name containing 'x64' (cpx* server types).

panels.title: Provisions/min (arm64)
panels.description: Successful ARM64 provisions per minute, 5-minute sliding window. Filters by template name containing 'aarch64' (cax* server types).

panels.title: Success rate (amd64)
panels.description: AMD64 provisioning success rate, 5-minute window. Empty (no activity) renders as 0 (the 'noValue' default); red below 90%, yellow 90-95%, green at or above 95%.

panels.title: Success rate (arm64)
panels.description: ARM64 provisioning success rate, 5-minute window. Same colouring as the amd64 panel.

panels.title: Stuck-build events (24h)
panels.description: AMD64 builds active for more than 24 hours. Non-zero means a build is hung on an amd64 worker.

panels.title: Builds running >24h (now)
panels.description: ARM64 builds active for more than 24 hours.

panels.title: Builds stuck >24h per master (now)
panels.description: Count of builds that crossed the 24h hang threshold in the last 24 hours. Emitted by HungBuildDetector PeriodicWork (v103.percona.17+). Healthy fleet is all zeros. Increments fire ONCE per build crossing the threshold, deduped via in-plugin cache. Includes template="unknown" under every Arch selection so builds the plugin could not attribute to an arch are never hidden (the hardcoded amd64/arm64 tiles 304/305 cannot show unknown).

panels.title: Oldest building build per master (age in seconds)
panels.description: For each master, the elapsed age of the longest-running building build right now. Emitted by HungBuildDetector PeriodicWork (v103.percona.17+). Green up to 12h, yellow up to 24h, red above. Cross-reference with `jenkins admin -i <master> incidents` for triage. Includes template="unknown" under every Arch selection so builds the plugin could not attribute to an arch are never hidden (the hardcoded amd64/arm64 tiles 304/305 cannot show unknown).

panels.title: Active workers per master
panels.description: Live count of Hetzner worker nodes currently provisioned per Jenkins master. Bar length is proportional to count; color shifts to yellow above 70% of master cap, red above 90%. Sorted descending by count.

panels.title: Fleet capacity roll-up
panels.description: One row per master with running/pending/cap/utilization side by side. Shows where the fleet has provisioning headroom and where it is at the ceiling. Masters that have never provisioned Hetzner workers (e.g. pmm.cd) will show empty values for running and pending.

targets.expr: sum by (master) (hetzner_running_servers{master=~"$master",arch=~"$arch"}) or on (master) (0 * group by (master) (hetzner_plugin_info{master=~"$master"}))

panels.title: Running workers per master over time
panels.description: Hetzner worker node count per master over the dashboard time range. Each line is a master; the y-value is the live count of running servers at that instant. Lines rise when workers spawn, fall when reaped. v103.percona.16+ refreshes the gauge every minute regardless of provisioning activity; pre-.16 masters can show stale flat lines (see panel 200 status). Pairs with panel 200 (instant view) and panel 201 (per-master capacity table).

panels.title: Worker templates per location
panels.description: How many configured Hetzner worker templates the fleet has per Hetzner datacenter (nbg1, fsn1, hel1, ash, hil, sin). Compare with the DC circuit breaker panel to spot DCs that are configured but consistently failing.

panels.title: DC circuit breaker state
panels.description: DC circuit-breaker state (source enum ordinals): 0 = CLOSED (healthy), 1 = OPEN (skipping the DC), 2 = HALF_OPEN (probing). One series per master/location/arch; responds to the Arch selector. Higher ordinal is not more severe, so colour is by value mapping (OPEN=red, HALF_OPEN=yellow), not a monotonic gradient.

panels.title: Provisioning success rate (5m)
panels.description: Successful provisions / total provision attempts, last 5 minutes. Shows 'no attempts' (not red) when the fleet is idle.

panels.title: Provisioning outcomes by class (5m)
panels.description: Per-class breakdown of hetzner_provision_attempts_total over the last 5 minutes. Reads alongside the success-rate gauge: the gauge says 'how many fail', this panel says 'why'. Key classes when triaging: bootstrap_other (Hetzner control-plane stall, see status.hetzner.com), bootstrap_io (master to agent SSH/network), rate_limited / unclassified_throttle (per-token API throttle), dc_unavailable / failover_incompatible (DC stockout or template mismatch), precheck_failure / config_error (template config error before any API call), cap_reached_under_lock (instance cap), failure (uncategorized; should stay near zero). dc_breaker_open (v26+): provision attempt skipped because the (location, arch) DC breaker was OPEN; pairs with reason=no_healthy_dc on the skipped panel.

panels.title: Provision latency p95 by template (5m)
panels.description: 95th percentile of hetzner_provision_duration_seconds_bucket, grouped by template label.

panels.title: API rate-limit headroom
panels.description: One line per Jenkins master = one independent Hetzner API token bucket (3600 req/hr per token, rolling 1h window). Each master has its own token, so red on one line does NOT affect the others. Green >=500 (healthy). Yellow 200-500 (provision storm forming, ~3-9 min headroom). Red <200 (near exhaustion; at 0 the plugin self-suppresses provisions for 60s on that master). Every API call counts, including rejected resource_unavailable create_server (e.g. CAX stockout).

panels.title: Pending provisions vs orphan reap rate
panels.description: In-flight provisions (left axis, count) overlaid with orphan-server reap rate (right axis, events/sec). A growing gap suggests provision attempts are leaking.

panels.title: Anomaly counters (last 1h)
panels.description: Increase over the last hour. CRW underflow + Uncaught are structural-fault canaries: any non-zero value indicates a code-level bug. Ghost nodes + DC failovers are routine events; small numbers are normal. Empty (no series) renders as 0. Stale HALF_OPEN/OPEN resets (v25/v26) re-arm a breaker probe lease whose holder died, or auto-reset a DC stuck OPEN past its TTL; small numbers are normal self-healing, sustained growth means breaker-lease churn.

panels.title: Hetzner-plugin log stream
panels.description: SLF4J output from the patched plugin (HetznerCloud, NodeCallable, OrphanedNodesCleaner, DcCircuitBreaker, HetznerApiClient, RateLimitInterceptor, RetryInterceptor, TemplateErrorTracker). For ps3-k8s the stream is live today; for the EC2 masters it appears once the master-side Alloy systemd unit ships (Phase 2.5c).

panels.title: Log rate by level (5m)
panels.description: Message rate by JUL level. Jenkins logs in single-line tab-delimited format: `<date>+<tz> [id=N]\t<LEVEL>\t<class>#<method>: <msg>`. Header lines abbreviate the package to `c.d.j.p.hetzner.X`; stack traces keep the full FQCN. Filter matches both forms.

panels.title: API request rate by status class
panels.description: Hetzner API request rate split by HTTP status class (2xx/4xx/5xx/network). Leading indicator before the rate-limit gauge moves during a Hetzner-side incident.

panels.title: API latency p95 / p99 by method
panels.description: Per-method Hetzner API latency. Tells you whether boot-time slowness is Hetzner-side (this panel) vs launcher-side (panel 3 'provision latency') vs token-throttle (panel 4 'rate-limit headroom').

panels.title: Capacity utilization per master (%)
panels.description: Per-master Hetzner capacity utilization = running workers / configured cap, as a percentage. One line per master. Green <70%, yellow 70-90%, red >=90% (at the ceiling; new provision requests will be rejected). Pairs with panel 201 (instant snapshot table) and panel 5 (pending vs orphan reap for leak detection). Raw running counts over time live in panel 203. Fleet-wide by necessity: hetzner_instance_cap has no arch label, so a per-arch utilization (arch running / total cap) would be misleading; use the Arch selector on panels 200/203 for per-arch running counts.

panels.title: Provision skipped + leaked
panels.description: Why provisions are NOT happening (skipped by reason) and whether the plugin had to declare a server leaked (provisioned but never reached the launcher). Answers 'builds are queueing but nothing spawns'.

panels.title: Distinct plugin versions
panels.description: Counts masters by reported in-memory Hetzner plugin version. Healthy fleet shows ONE version. Multiple values means classloader/runtime drift even if the installed .jpi files are byte-identical (a busy master needs JVM restart).

panels.title: Plugin version per master
panels.description: Live Hetzner plugin version reported by each master via hetzner_plugin_info. Use this to confirm a fleet rollout has activated (busy masters retain the prior in-memory version until JVM restart). Cross-check with the Drift stat panel above for fleet-wide skew.

panels.title: API rate-limit headroom (%)
panels.description: Percentage of the per-master Hetzner API token quota remaining (hetzner_api_rate_limit_remaining / hetzner_api_rate_limit_limit * 100). Tokens are per-master (verified 2026-05-21 via SHA-256 fingerprints).

panels.title: Tokens rate-limited (now)
panels.description: Count of masters whose Hetzner API token is currently blocked by a 429 (hetzner_api_rate_limited). The gauge is lazy: absent until a master first hits a 429 after restart, so 0 is filled in explicitly.

panels.title: Fleet JVM restarts (24h)
panels.description: Jenkins controller restarts across the fleet, counted via steps of hetzner_dc_health_saves_created (the counter-registration timestamp jumps on every JVM start). Restarts reset every hetzner_* counter, so spikes here explain counters dropping to zero.

panels.title: DC circuit breaker transitions (5m rate, per location)
panels.description: Rate of CLOSED<->OPEN<->HALF_OPEN transitions per DC location. Sustained non-zero values indicate churn (cycling between failing and probing). The `arch` dim (v25+) is collapsed via `by (master, location, to)`.

panels.title: Leaked Hetzner VMs per master (5m rate)
panels.description: Rate of provisioned VMs that the plugin could not adopt as Jenkins agents (per hetzner_provision_leaked_servers_total). Pre-PKG-1334 cloud.cd ran ~30/hr leaks; post-fix steady-state is ~1/hr. Sustained elevation is a PKG-1334-class regression detector (userdata blocking SSH, image arch mismatch, etc.).

panels.title: Per-arch DC breaker matrix (v25+ masters)
panels.description: Per-(master, location, arch) DC breaker state. 0=CLOSED, 1=OPEN, 2=HALF_OPEN. The fleet now emits the `arch` label on every master that runs the breaker (9/9 provisioning masters); responds to the Arch selector. Canonical per-(DC, arch) deprioritization view.

panels.title: Worker demand vs capacity per master
panels.description: Worker demand (busy executors on Hetzner workers) vs supply (running Hetzner servers) per master, over the dashboard time range. Demand at or above supply means workers are fully booked (scale-up pressure); supply well above demand means idle burn. The supply line responds to the Arch selector (native `arch` label, amd64/arm64); the demand line is fleet-wide because hetzner_jenkins_real_busy_executors carries no arch label, so narrowing Arch filters only the running line. Pairs with panel 203 (supply only) and panel 201 (per-master capacity table).

panels.title: Template health
panels.description: Per worker template (location, server_type): configured executor capacity alongside two health signals. Suppressed=1 means the template was pulled out of provisioning rotation; Errors is the consecutive provision-error count. Capacity comes from hetzner_template_executors and the location/server_type columns from hetzner_template_info (joined by template); the launcher-x64 templates appear under both their fallback server types (cpx22 and cpx32). The Suppressed and Errors columns are empty on a healthy fleet (those metrics are event-driven and emit only once a template trips) and light up red the moment a template is suppressed or starts erroring, so a server type silently dropping out of rotation becomes visible. Filtered by Arch via the template name (x64/aarch64).

panels.title: DC breaker pressure (consecutive failures)
panels.description: Leading indicator for the DC circuit breaker (panel 1 shows only the post-trip state). hetzner_dc_circuit_breaker_consecutive_failures increments on each failed provision and resets to 0 on the first success. The breaker opens at FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 2 consecutive failures (source: DcCircuitBreaker.java). One series per master/location/arch; responds to the Arch selector. Thresholds: green 0 (healthy), yellow 1 (one failure away from tripping), red >= 2 (at/over the trip count; breaker OPEN). The gauge can read above 2 while OPEN/HALF_OPEN probes keep failing.

panels.title: Orphan cleanup latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of hetzner_orphan_cleanup_duration_seconds_bucket per master (the orphan reaper that destroys leaked Hetzner servers). Sibling to panel 3 (provision latency). No arch/template label on this metric, so it is master-scoped only. NOTE: orphan cleanup is low-frequency, so the [5m] rate window leaves most points NaN (sparse, dotted line). If the line is too gappy, widen the rate window to [30m] (same p95 values, continuous line).

panels.title: API + rehydrate anomalies (last 1h)
panels.description: Increase over the last hour of API/lifecycle fault counters. Retries-exhausted = the plugin gave up after exhausting retries on a Hetzner call (API pressure or persistent fault). Token invalidated = a Hetzner API token was rejected/rotated (401). Rehydrate failures = a worker could not be re-adopted after a master restart. All are arch-agnostic and summed fleet-wide. Empty (no series) renders as 0; small numbers can be transient, sustained growth means a real API/credential/restart problem.

list.name: arch
list.label: Arch
list.description: Filter panels by worker architecture. Regex-valued so the same value matches the `template` label (cpx*->x64, cax*->aarch64) AND the native `arch` label (amd64/arm64): All=.*, amd64=(.*x64.*|.*amd64.*), arm64=(.*aarch64.*|.*arm64.*).
